name: Easy GitHack Viewer
description: Simplifies the process of viewing HTML files hosted on GitHub with raw.githack.com. It automatically formats and displays the content for easy viewing, eliminating the need for manual adjustments. Just click to load any GitHub-hosted HTML file, and it will open in an optimized, readable format, making it quicker and more efficient for developers to preview and share their web projects. Perfect for anyone working with GitHub-hosted HTML files
